insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Errors
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their apps to handle the new error response. They should ensure that their queries only filter by metafields that are set up for filtering. This change may require updates to existing code, especially in areas where metafield filtering is used. Developers can use the `metafield` object to check if a metafield is set up for filtering before querying.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice more accurate results from apps that use the GraphQL Admin API. This change may also reduce the number of support requests related to incorrect results.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy and reliability of the GraphQL Admin API, which is essential for building robust and trustworthy apps. It also helps developers catch errors earlier, reducing the risk of downstream issues.

updates.title: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers
updates.summary: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: Invalid metafield queries in the GraphQL Admin API now return errors instead of incorrect results.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page building.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, simplifying the process of building merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview introduces new inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
CLI version 4.5.2 fixes warnings when running theme commands and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate for authentication.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: Hydrogen CLI version 13.0.2 adds non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags and a force flag to bypass confirmation prompts.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: App Store requirements have been updated to include the use of unique app names to reduce merchant confusion.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API now supports the channelId argument in the @inContext directive, allowing for channel-specific context.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: New fields have been added to the ExchangeLineItem type, including productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance printing, error handling, and app development

themes.title: API Enhancements
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, and metafield triggers are available for events. These updates improve data handling and reduce errors in apps using the GraphQL Admin API.

themes.title: App Development and Extensions
themes.detail: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers, and full-stack capabilities are available to power app analytics. Liquid templates can also compose pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme development.
